_comment: Everything the game can be tuned with. Every key is optional:
anything left out keeps the built-in default, so a file that only
sets a seed is a valid configuration.
random_seed  pins the one shared random generator, so a whole
session replays identically - arena, power-up drops
and every later draw. Remove it for a different game
map.seed     pins only the arena. Useful for 'this map plays
map.layout   an explicit arena; wins over map.seed. See
config.handmade.json for the legend and an example.
